predicted_positive: At least one scanner finding at or above the threshold; a raw signal, not an agent safety verdict
error_policy: Errors are unassessed, never silently counted as TN; report them separately and exit nonzero
unchecked_policy: Report incomplete scans separately, including negatives with unchecked content; never equate a negative signal with SAFE
severity_policy: Only score exact severity where explicitly annotated; minimum annotations measure threshold compliance and do not establish over-severity
development_policy: 140 frozen cases only; expected topic and annotated-file results separate from raw alert metrics; corpus is author-written
external_policy: All 116 pinned deepset public test rows, unmodified upstream labels, no scanner-result filtering; exact severity and category accuracy unassessed
holdout_policy: The 60 local holdout cases are not scored by this runner
tuning_policy: No detection-rule or threshold tuning against the external baseline in this iteration
